## Checklist

- [ ] App (`frontend/`): `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass (CI runs them too)
- [ ] Backend (`backend/`, if touched): `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run test:api` pass
- [ ] Checked on Android in **English and Arabic** (RTL)
- [ ] New API calls are in `docs/API.md`, with mock + http implementations
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
